title: Claims
description: Tracked (corpus/claims.json): the claims the documents make, each naming the surfaces whose axes it takes. The prober refuses a file that does not match this schema when it reads one (decision 102).

schemaVersion.description: The schema version. A file or line without it is version 1 (the Python baseline).

source.description: file#heading of the document that states it

narrow.description: axis dropped, with the source sentence that limits it (checked verbatim)

obligations.description: what the claim promises, each checkable on its own: a sentence quoted verbatim from the claim's source document (checked as a narrowing is), under an id a probe's seed names (decision 104); a claim without the field has one obligation, the claim itself, under the id `claim`

axes.description: the axis values the obligation concerns, where it is not the whole claim

not-promised.description: what the claim does not promise, one entry per intended difference: the sentence of the document or record that makes it intended, quoted verbatim from `source` (checked as a narrowing is), and the axis values it concerns; a note key of outcome expected-refusal, a narrowing or an applicability condition cites an entry by its id (decision 104)

source.description: file#heading of the document or record that states it

axes.description: the axis values or shapes the difference concerns

exclude.description: pairs no row can hold, each group with the reason why; `prober universe` prints the reasons, since nothing checks them mechanically

reason.description: one sentence saying why the pairs cannot exist or are not promised, citing a docs sentence, a record or a KB fact where one applies
